errors.evidence: In the figure, the series for 60 % des Medianlohns der Vollzeitbeschäftigten is shown in purple/magenta, not red.

errors.text_span: Die Werte für den gesetzlichen Mindestlohn betragen für 2015 8,50, für 2020 9,55 und für 2025 12,82.
errors.evidence: The 2020 legal minimum wage is labeled 9,35 in the figure, not 9,55; 12,82 is the 2025 value, but the description omits the 2024 value and otherwise selectively cites years.

errors.text_span: Die Werte für 60 % des Medianlohns der Vollzeitbeschäftigten betragen für 2015 10,59, für 2020 12,13 und für 2025 15,12.
errors.evidence: The figure shows the 2015 purple bar at 10,59 and 2020 at 12,13, but the 2025 purple bar is shown with a hatched style and value 15,12; however the reference notes the hatched treatment is a special feature that is omitted. The main issue is the description gives only a few selected values and does not accurately reflect the full displayed series.
The description omits that the purple bars for 2024 and 2025 have a hatched/striped fill, a visible stylistic feature noted in the figure and reference.
